---
name: grill-me
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
---

Interview the user in rounds until you reach a shared understanding. Treat the plan as a decision tree. In each round, ask every question whose prerequisites are settled, number the questions, and give a recommended answer. Wait for the user's answers before the next round. Defer questions that depend on unanswered ones.

Find factual answers from the available environment or tools instead of asking the user. Finish only when every decision is covered and the user confirms the shared understanding. Do not act on the plan before then.
